---
title: Published arena specifications
description: Dimensions and components of the original thermal–visual arena.
section: Reference design
---
Specifications below are from **Methods: Thermal–visual place learning arena** and **Figure 1** of the [original paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature10131).

| Component | Published specification |
| --- | --- |
| Aluminium ring diameter | 8 inches (203.2 mm) |
| Ring height | 3 mm |
| Peltier floor | 64 individually controlled modules in an 8 × 8 grid |
| Module footprint | 1 × 1 inch (25.4 × 25.4 mm) |
| Walking-surface covering | Black masking tape |
| Lid | Glass disk treated with Sigmacote |
| Ring heater | 29 AWG Nichrome 60 wire with Kapton insulation |
| Ring temperature | Above 50 °C |
| Warm floor / cool tile | 36 °C / 25 °C |
| LED matrix | 24 × 192 LEDs |
| Visual bars | Vertical, horizontal and diagonal; 15° width at the centre |
| Maximum viewing distance | 8.8 inches (223.52 mm) |
| Behaviour recording | Basler 622f CMOS camera, IR-pass filter and IR illumination |
| Temperature verification | Thermal imaging and thermocouples |

## Dimensions used in this build

The measured inner diameter of this build is **200 mm**. The paper does not identify its ring diameter as an inner or outer measurement. Use the measured assembly dimensions for CAD and image calibration.

The documented build uses 60 background modules, four separate target channels and eight P4 panels. Its [controller settings](../firmware/index.md) are listed separately from the published temperatures above.
